name: 55 Bank AVL, linked accounts and W2B
description: Ticket 117e (FRS UC-14, UC-15, EXT-12, FL-08, FL-09, MCK-03). mw-simulators plays the 20 generated bank-<code> gateway profiles (REST dbbl / ebl, SOAP sonali) with seeded accounts (seed/v1/bank-accounts.csv: 1234567890 Rahim Uddin at every bank) and the MCK-03 triggers (account ending 00 not found, 95 credit by callback; amount .77 a 500 that was applied, .99 an ambiguous refusal that was not). Linking runs AVL first and stores the account encrypted, answering its last 4 digits and the holder's initial only. W2B holds the payer's funds, credits the linked account and commits on the bank's confirmation. T1-T4 and T6-T10 for W2B; add money from a linked account (C2W debit confirmed by callback) is the UC-14 regression next to folder 08. T5 waits out the inquiry schedule (bank read timeout 27s), T11 and T12 stay n/a (tickets 125 and 127). USSD Transfer to Bank stays app-only (user decision 2026-11-20).
